Theme

Travel & transport

parking space noun

also parking spot, parking place, parking

classical

locus, locī m.

noun, second declension

a place, a space

A plain place: locum quaerimus, we’re looking for a space; locus vacuus, a free one. To park is autoraedam statuere, and the car park ārea statīva (Traupman 217).

Other words

  • spatium, spatiī n. — a space, room

    noun, second declension · also used · classical · Andresian p. 41

    Room, a space (Lewis & Short); Andresian’s picture seems to show a car turning into a space. Less definite than locus, and also the word for a stretch of time.

Examples

  • Ecce locus vacuus!

    There’s a free space!composed

See also park, car park, car.
